text_block_list.text: Some time has passed since we began preparing for the Hanshin JF—

Right now, I was agonizing over
how to handle Lucky Lilac's
upcoming training.
choice_data_list: (...It's still not enough for Luck to grow)

text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac is an exceptionally talented Umamusume.
Possessing innate talent alongside the patience and diligence
to quietly power through any training—

Furthermore, she has the diligence to identify her own weaknesses and seek out solutions.
This is precisely why she's regarded as an honor student.

"And her greatest strength, one that mustn't be forgotten,
is her explosive power to fearlessly dive in at the crucial moment."
The guts and competitive instinct to take the fight directly to Orfevre without flinching are rare, invaluable weapons that cannot easily be taught.
Blessed with so many strengths, Lucky Lilac is someone a Trainer can rely on immensely, but—

"...The 'spotlight' she aims for
is a realm one can only reach by making race history,
just like Orfevre."

Merely being slightly better than the rest isn't enough.
I have to aim much higher.

An extraordinary presence
that will be talked about for generations to come.

"...Even though I feel that way, the reality is
I don't know specifically what I should be doing.
Taking a walk around the academy for a change of pace—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —I see. So training is going well, then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In terms of numbers, things are steadily improving.
For now, we just want to keep steadily building on this.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of Lara-chan.
She's so reliable and steady.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: âAh, Lala-chan's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all. We were just having a chat, the two of us.

The Umamusume smiling like that was named Buena Vista.
Her gentle, warm demeanor was striking,
and while I had heard she was friends with Lucky Lilac—

With a career boasting six GⅠ victories,
she possesses exceptional strength even among Tiara Umamusume.
When it comes to racing, she is, to Lucky Lilac, a great predecessor.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: âLook, didn't Buena-san win the 'Hanshin JF' as well?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
So we've been talking a lot lately.
Well, mostly it's just me talking
and her listening, though.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm genuinely happy, you know? That you rely on me.
I'll do whatever I can to help, so just leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch.
That's what makes you so lovely, Buena.

...Buena Vista has won the Hanshin JF in
the past, earning her the title of
Junior Class Queen Umamusume.
In that sense, she might truly be the best role model for Lucky Lilac right now.
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Paced running is the main focus today, is it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's dive right into thorough, practical training.
Yeah. Let's do some rigorous, practical-style training.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Understood. And what about your partner?
It looks like they haven't arrived yet, though—
I'm sorry, I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh—
Buena-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry to keep you waiting.
My apologies!
choice_data_list: No, I was just about to get started.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that.
...Lala, I'll be in your care today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes.
Please take good care of me...
choice_data_list: Today I'm going to have Buena Vista run seriously.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since I've gotten serious, but don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll never, ever let you down.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want her to take it all in.
Just how strong I am, Lala-chan.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……Understood.
I'll gladly take you up on that offer to spar.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (So this is Buena-san... going all out...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(She's usually such a lovely, smiling person,
but this intimidating aura isn't cute at all...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Still, bring it on...!
I'm gonna show 'em how I run!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, keeping the lead into the final stretch!
I managed to get into the best position...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(If I go now, I can take this all the way!!
I'm pullin' away...!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Here we go, Lala-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Y-You gotta be kiddin' me... !?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What a final sprint...! That acceleration is insane...!
It's totally different from watching it on video...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (So this is the running of a queen-class Umamusume—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... Gh...—
choice_data_list: Alright, let's call it a day!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Lala-chan.
Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, please call on me anytime.
I'll come running right away.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
âWell, then... Could I ask you again...
sometime soon...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I learned so much today.
For the sake of my future, I want to watch Buena-san run up close even more...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me. I'll run with you as many times as you want until you're satisfied, Lala-chan.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you once again
for giving me the opportunity to train alongside Buena-san today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I was letting it get
to my head a bit. Things have been going
so lucky and smooth up till now."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Still, after running alongside Buena-san today,
I understand it crystal clear now."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The path I'm walking right now...
Just how high of a peak did the one before me reach?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And that to reach those heights...
I have to push myself way harder.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to brace myself and focus again starting today.
So Trainer, please push me even harder.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I will endure and definitely prove it to you.
By the Hanshin JF, to Buena-san—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"That I really am an Umamusume
who can become a 'star.'"
The goal of today's tandem run with Buena Vista was to give Lucky Lilac, who had been progressing smoothly, a concrete wall to overcome.

I thought Buena Vista would show her heights in a different way than Orfevre,
but it seems the effect exceeded my expectations.
choice_data_list: I've gained a new appreciation for your strengths too, Luck.
I've come to realize Lucky's strengths all over again, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Our strong point, you ask?

Facing a superior rival going all out is a double-edged sword.
Being forced to realize the massive gap between you can
bring an otherwise steady momentum to a complete halt.
Yet Lucky Lilac did not falter. Standing before the summit, she recognized her shortcomings and continued to challenge herself without fear—

She chose to keep charging headlong—
against superior rivals, and against her own limits...!
choice_data_list: You really are Tsukkomi Lilac after all!
You really are Tsukkomi Lilac after all!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—There had to be a better way to put it!
The heck is 'Tsukkomi Lilac' even supposed to mean?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
..................*Ahem*.
Well, I get what you're trying to say.
So that's why—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I won't be satisfied with how things are—
I'll keep charging straight ahead.
I'll be counting on you too, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll do my best as the comedic Lilac!
Yeah, I'll do my best as the funny-man, Lilac!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Don't turn it into a stage name!!
With renewed determination for the Hanshin JF, Lucky Lilac charges straight ahead—
